mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a three-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.2pp over 3 months, or the signal fails to outperform baseline in walk-forward IC tests.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a bearish sentiment shift and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 102.5 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of a near-term economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 102.5 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts above 1.2 million units in a single month signals strong consumer confidence and rising demand for durable goods, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST exceeds 1200.0, or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 in walk-forward testing.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a delayed monetary policy response, which increases real rate uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of high CPI and low FEDFUNDS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward analysis.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth above 250k in a single month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals labor market overheating and increases the probability of imminent monetary tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during PAYEMS > 250k and UNRATE < 5.1% periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction term fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 445 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates strong consumer demand and a robust economic cycle, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of RSAFS > 445000.0 and HOUST > 1170.0 fails to predict positive 20-day SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term has a Rank IC < 0.03 in walk-forward testing.
